title: 重物搬运
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/149_重物搬运.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/149_重物搬运/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着一个纸箱，腰背挺直
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a cardboard box close to its chest with a straight back, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第13章第三课：重物搬运。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着自己的腰
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at its own lower back with a serious face.
shots.narration: 腰伤，常在一弯一扭之间。

shots.scene: 到货的试剂箱放在实验室门口地上
shots.prompt_en: A delivered heavy box of reagent bottles sits on the floor at the door of a university laboratory.
shots.narration: 一箱试剂送到了门口。

shots.scene: 阿杰直着腿弯腰去拽箱子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends at the waist with straight legs and pulls the heavy box up.
shots.narration: 阿杰直腿弯腰，一把拽起。

shots.scene: 他抱着箱子扭身往高架上放
shots.prompt_en: The young male student twists his body while lifting the box toward a high shelf.
shots.narration: 又扭着身子，往高架上举。

shots.scene: 阿杰捂着腰，王老师赶来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds his lower back in pain as the safety administrator hurries over.
shots.narration: 腰一闪，疼得直不起来。

shots.scene: 试剂箱、溶剂桶、仪器、气瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a reagent box, a solvent drum, an instrument and a gas cylinder, each with a weight mark. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室里，也常要搬重东西。

shots.scene: 弯腰硬拽、扭身，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a figure pulling a load with a bent back and another twisting with a load, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 弯腰硬拽、负重扭身，最伤腰。

shots.scene: 搬前看重量、大小、路线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a load with three icons, a weight scale, a size ruler and a route arrow through a door. No text.
shots.narration: 搬前先看：多重、多大、走哪条路。

shots.scene: 通道上的杂物被清走
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: boxes and cables being cleared from a corridor before carrying a load through it. No text.
shots.narration: 先清通道，看好放在哪里。

shots.scene: 一人和推车两个选项，推车打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person carrying a heavy box versus a trolley carrying it, the trolley with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 能用推车，就别靠手搬。

shots.scene: 阿杰试着推推箱子掂量
shots.prompt_en: The young male student gently pushes the box to test its weight before lifting.
shots.narration: 先掂量，自己能不能搬动。

shots.scene: 【实拍】站到箱子跟前，双脚分开站稳（全身侧面）
shots.prompt_en: Side view: a person steps close to a box on the floor with feet apart, one foot slightly forward.
shots.narration: 靠近物品，双脚分开站稳。

shots.scene: 【实拍】背挺直，屈膝慢慢蹲下（全身侧面）
shots.prompt_en: Side view: the person keeps the back straight and bends the knees to squat down beside the box.
shots.narration: 背挺直，屈膝慢慢蹲下。

shots.scene: 直腿弯腰搬箱，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a figure lifting a box with straight legs and a rounded back, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别直着腿、弓着腰去搬。

shots.scene: 【实拍】双手抓牢两侧，用腿发力起身，箱子贴胸前（全身侧面）
shots.prompt_en: Side view: the person grips both sides of the box, stands up using the legs, holding the box close to the chest.
shots.narration: 抓牢两侧，用腿的力量起身。

shots.scene: 箱子贴身，不挡视线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person carrying a box close to the body at waist height with a clear line of sight ahead. No text.
shots.narration: 东西贴近身体，别挡住视线。

shots.scene: 【实拍】抱着箱子，迈步用脚转身（全身俯视或侧面）
shots.prompt_en: Medium shot: a person holding a box close turns by stepping the feet around instead of twisting the waist.
shots.narration: 转身时用脚转，不扭腰。

shots.scene: 走路时箱子一直贴身
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person walking slowly with a box held close, short steps. No text.
shots.narration: 走路时，东西始终贴着身体。

shots.scene: 放下：直背、屈膝、轻放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person lowering a box to the floor with a straight back and bent knees. No text.
shots.narration: 放下时反过来：直背、屈膝、轻放。

shots.scene: 手先从箱底撤出，别夹手
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: fingers sliding out from under a box edge as it touches the floor, a pinch point marked. No text.
shots.narration: 放稳后再撤手，当心夹手。

shots.scene: 太大太重的箱子，一个人打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one person struggling with an oversized heavy crate, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 太重太大，别逞强。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰合抬，一人喊口令
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student lift a crate together, one counting the timing aloud.
shots.narration: 两人合抬，喊着口令一起用力。

shots.scene: 推车运箱，或拆成小份分批
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heavy load moved on a trolley, and a big carton split into smaller boxes carried in batches. No text.
shots.narration: 没人帮，就用推车或分批搬。

shots.scene: 能搬多重，按规定和自身能力
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person beside a balance icon weighing a box against a personal capability icon and a rule book. No text.
shots.narration: 能搬多重，按本校规定和自身能力。

shots.scene: 气瓶推车和液氮罐推车
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas cylinder strapped on a cylinder trolley and a liquid nitrogen dewar on a wheeled base. No text.
shots.narration: 气瓶、液氮罐，用专用推车。

shots.scene: 阿杰倒着拉推车，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student walking backwards pulling a loaded trolley, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 推车用推，别倒着拉。

shots.scene: 货物码稳，不高过视线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: boxes stacked low and stable on a trolley, the pusher can see over them. No text.
shots.narration: 货物码稳，别挡住视线。

shots.scene: 把手齐腰，手臂放松，慢走
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person pushing a trolley with handles at waist height and relaxed arms, walking slowly. No text.
shots.narration: 把手齐腰，手臂放松，走慢点。

shots.scene: 过门槛有人帮扶
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer steadies a loaded trolley as the young male student pushes it over a door threshold.
shots.narration: 过门槛、坡道，有人帮扶。

shots.scene: 货架：重物在中下层，轻物在上层
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shelf with heavy boxes on the lower and middle shelves and light items on the top shelf. No text.
shots.narration: 重的放中下层，轻的才放高处。

shots.scene: 把重物举过头顶，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person lifting a heavy box above the head onto a high shelf, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别把重物举过头顶，伤肩又易砸。

shots.scene: 常用物品放在腰到肩之间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: frequently used items placed between waist and shoulder height on a shelf, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 常用的东西，放在顺手的高度。

shots.scene: 单手拎沉重的电源模块，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one hand carrying a heavy power supply module by an edge, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 仪器部件很沉，别单手拎。

shots.scene: 双手托底搬部件，脚穿防砸鞋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two hands supporting a heavy module from below, feet in safety shoes. No text.
shots.narration: 双手托底，穿好防砸的劳保鞋。

shots.scene: 两人慢慢放倒设备
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the young male student slowly tilt a heavy instrument onto its side together.
shots.narration: 放倒扶正，两人配合慢慢来。

shots.scene: 脚伸在设备下面，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a foot under the edge of a heavy machine being lowered, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 手脚别伸到设备下面。

shots.scene: 升降台剪叉处，手伸进去打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand reaching into the scissor joints of a lab jack, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 升降台交叉处，手别伸进去。

shots.scene: 重物放在台面中间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heavy optical plate placed in the middle of a bench, another hanging over the edge crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 重物放台面中间，别悬在台边。

shots.scene: 新到的大型仪器木箱停在楼下
shots.prompt_en: A large wooden crate with a new instrument waits at the entrance of a laboratory building.
shots.narration: 大型仪器进实验室，学生别硬抬。

shots.scene: 专业搬运队用液压搬运车，有人指挥
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: professional movers with a pallet jack moving the crate while one person directs. No text.
shots.narration: 找专业队伍，用搬运设备，专人指挥。

shots.scene: 检查楼板承重、门宽、电梯和路线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a floor load icon, a door width ruler, an elevator and a route map checked off. No text.
shots.narration: 先确认楼板承重、门宽和路线。

shots.scene: 抱起大桶倒溶剂，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person hugging a large solvent drum and tilting it to pour into a bottle, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 抱起大桶倒溶剂，伤腰又易洒。

shots.scene: 【实拍】用手动桶泵把桶里液体分装进小瓶（手部特写，用清水）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand operating a manual drum pump transferring clear liquid from a drum into a small bottle.
shots.narration: 用手动泵或倾倒架，省力不洒。

shots.scene: 在通风良好处分装，远离火源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: dispensing done in a well ventilated area with a no open flames sign nearby. No text.
shots.narration: 在通风处分装，远离火源。

shots.scene: 桶和接收容器接地跨接
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a metal drum and a receiving can connected by bonding and grounding wires. No text.
shots.narration: 易燃溶剂，做好接地跨接。

shots.scene: 评估、推车、合抬
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a checklist, a trolley and two people lifting together. No text.
shots.narration: 先评估，能推车就推车，太重找人。

shots.scene: 屈膝、直背、贴身、用脚转
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, bent knees, a straight back, a load close to the body and stepping feet. No text.
shots.narration: 屈膝直背，贴身起，用脚转身。

shots.scene: 重物低放、托底、专业队伍、用泵
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a low shelf, hands supporting from below, a pallet jack and a drum pump. No text.
shots.narration: 重物低放，大件找专业，大桶用泵。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着耳罩挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears hearing protection earmuffs and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：噪声与听力保护。
